Given below are two statements:
Statement I: Specific forces of the business environment affect all business enterprises in an industry equally.
Statement II: General forces like technological and economic trends exert an impact on all business firms indirectly.

In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

1. Statement I is false: Specific forces (investors, customers, competitors) affect an individual enterprise directly, not all firms equally.
